messages:
Alex: Quick design question — in the trace drilldown, where should the Export action live? Next to the trace title in the top-left toolbar, or inside the kebab menu on the right? Accessibility + keyboard focus are my main concerns. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/mock/trace-drilldown.png

Maya: My instinct is kebab menu. Export is not a primary action for most users and putting it in the toolbar clutters the focus order. :thinking:

Sam: Agree with Maya for visual simplicity, but exporting is common for SREs. If it's in the kebab, we should add a visible keyboard shortcut and an `aria-label` so screenreaders can find it quickly.

Jamie: If we move it to kebab, can we still show a small export icon when the trace has an error flag? So power users see the affordance without it stealing space. Also check color contrast on the icon hover state — currently fails AA when the background is dark.

Irene: Copy nit: instead of just "Export", use "Export trace (JSON)" or "Download trace" so screenreaders give context. Also for keyboard focus make sure the order is: title -> breadcrumbs -> actions. Right now the export sits between breadcrumbs and the title which is weird.

Alex: Good points. Two requirements: 1) keep focus order clean; 2) make export discoverable by SREs. Thoughts on adding a small persistent export icon + move full export + format options into the kebab?

Maya: That seems like a good compromise. Persistent icon could be `button[aria-label=\"Quick export trace\"]` with tooltip. Full options (JSON, HAR, CSV?) in kebab.

Sam: Implementation detail: make quick export a `button` not a link so it receives programmatic focus. Example aria: `button aria-label=\"Quick export trace (JSON)\" aria-describedby=\"export-help\"`. We should also announce the download filename to SR: "Trace-<correlation_id>.json".

Jamie: Accessibility nits: keyboard trap in stack frames modal still exists. If we add the icon into the toolbar, double-check modal open/close focus return. And ensure the export action doesn't steal the `Enter` behavior when a row is selected.

Irene: Also, when a user clicks the correlation ID to copy, make sure we run `aria-live` announce: "Correlation ID copied to clipboard". Right now copy button just changes color with no announcement. :eyes:

Alex: Good call. Can we agree on these next steps? 1) Persist quick export icon (left of kebab) with `aria-label=\"Quick export trace (JSON)\"`. 2) Put format/options in kebab. 3) Add keyboard shortcut `Shift+E` for quick export and show it in tooltip. 4) Improve contrast on hover. 5) Add aria-live for correlation id copy.

Maya: +1 to all. I'll mock up two variants (icon-only vs icon+label) and include focus order markups.

Sam: I'll add the aria attributes and a small snippet for copy announcement. Example: `div aria-live=\"polite\" id=\"clipboard-announcer\"` then JS: `announcer.textContent = 'Correlation ID copied';`.

Jamie: I'll run a quick a11y check on hover states and modal focus. If contrast fails, I'll propose a color token change.

Irene: Will create a short acceptance test for keyboard flow and SR announcements.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-24T02:15:00Z for the trace UX tweaks.

Alex: Thanks team — if Maya posts mocks, we can pick variant and I’ll slot it into the next sprint. :sparkles:
